scope: All five non-parametrised TestWordAnchorDiscovery declarations in tests/test_word_anchor_discovery.py; source review only. Anchor inspection, document-map responses, discovered-heading insertion and section-list next-tool hints.

implementation.use: decorator for tracked insertion writer; separate mutation safety is not established here
save path used by insertion; no package custody assertion in these tests

targetedFamily.boundary: The candidate IDs are unexecuted local catalogue descriptions, not distinct evidence; the five source declarations alone fix this denominator. Other Word insertion/section tests are not counted. Native assertions do not verify whole-package preservation or renderer conformance.

verifiedAspects: On a four-paragraph input, anchor count is at least four; among anchors is section_heading Introduction and a paragraph containing Customer context.
gaps: The native test does not require every input paragraph to appear or assert ordering, indexes, nearby sections, absence of extra anchors or unchanged source bytes.

verifiedAspects: Query delivery returns at least one anchor and all returned anchor_text values contain delivery after lowercasing.
gaps: Completeness and exact count of matching anchors, exclusions by kind, ordering and unchanged source bytes are not asserted.

verifiedAspects: A heading, placeholder paragraph and 2x2 table produce counts: sections exactly one, tables exactly one, placeholders at least one, anchors at least two, plus truthy anchors list.
gaps: No exact placeholder or anchor list, section/table content details, map ordering, source bytes or output renderer is asserted.

verifiedAspects: Discover an anchor with text Delivery approach; insertion with position after reports success true; reopening from the saved source path finds inserted text immediately after that heading using track-change-aware paragraph text.
gaps: No exact archive/member custody, complete paragraph order, revision structure or independent Office rendering is asserted; the readback is python-docx on the saved path rather than a separate renderer.

verifiedAspects: Listing sections returns next_tools containing word_list_anchors and word_document_map.
gaps: The test does not assert the sections list or call anchor discovery, document map, section guidance, or a subsequent edit.
